main_text.l: Suspendo, ich hencke auff/ ich hencke an/suspendi,
Tendo, ich strecke auß / ich spanne auß/tetendi, tensum.
Tollo, ich hebe auff/ich nim hinweg/ suftuli, sublatum.
Vergo,ich neige mich gegen/ absq; præterito & supino.
Veho,ich führe auffm schiff/ roß/ wagen / vexi, vectum.
Verto, ich wende umb / ich verdolmetsche / verti, versum.
Vomo, ich kotze / ich gebe die speise wider/ vomui, vomitum.

page.notes: Line-end words "tensum", "versum" and "vomitum" are continuations of the lines above and are printed as such. Some German words are hard to read at this scan resolution, notably "vngestümlich", "kotze" and "wältze"; they are transcribed as they appear. A dark smudge sits on "ich gehe" in the Vado entry; the reading "gehe" is likely but not certain. Possible printing errors include "vexi" with "vectum" split across lines, and "tetendi" followed by "tensum" on the next line.
